data.body:
GAP_AC_AMENDMENT: Alias collision handling in resolve_ticket_id().
Additional AC: when alias scan matches multiple tickets (improbable but possible if first 12 hex chars of two UUIDs collide), resolve_ticket_id must exit non-zero and print 'Ambiguous alias: matches <id1> <id2> ...' to stderr — same pattern as ambiguous prefix handling. Do NOT silently return the first match. Add a test: manually inject two tickets with the same alias (by creating test fixtures) and verify the resolver returns error + lists both IDs.
